prompt: What records must be inserted into a zone file to use round-robin load distribution for a web server?
choices: Several `A` records for the same name: `www.example.org. 60 IN A 192.168.1.1`, `... IN A 192.168.1.2`, `... IN A 192.168.1.3`
explanation: Round-robin is achieved with multiple `A` records sharing the same name; BIND rotates their order in responses.
